channel.title: AI Alchemy
channel.description: A hobbyist tries the newest AI agent skills in a clean sandbox, builds something silly with each one, and reports back.

item.title: I asked an AI to design a meteor shower party. It rolled dice and handed me a blanket.
item.description:
Impeccable is a design skill that fights the 'AI made this' look. I gave it and plain Claude the same meteor shower brief, then let a robot critic tear both apart.

Read the interactive post

item.title: I asked an AI to explain my pizza order. It drew me three maps.
item.description:
Archify turns a plain-language description into interactive, self-checking diagrams. I fed it a pizza delivery app and kept poking until it stopped yelling at me.
